name: Copenhagen
limitations: Conditional research case only. 31 partial states do not mean fully measured. Conditional centre only when every assumption is accepted. MED/PCS40 materially defensible; reject necessary links to null with original weights. No ranking/Top32 result.

dimensions.rationale: Historical moderated heat and low earthquake exposure plus completed rain-flood works support scoped protection. Current warm-drought pressure, unfinished major tunnels and planned storm-surge gates retain important coastal/common-hazard gaps; future capacity is not operating protection.
dimensions.assumption: Accept principal hazards/local references represent ordinary537 exposure, completed works normally effective, and usual thermal adaptation adequate; essential coastal assets must not face dominating unmitigated exposure. Significant exposure/protection gap40; stronger effective combination80; reject these connections to null.

dimensions.rationale: Actual local organised violence and cross-border enforcement, recent strategic threat assessment and implemented security responses support normally low daily impact with important regional/hybrid exposure. Airport closure is real; reported drones and Russian responsibility are not established for that event.
dimensions.assumption: Accept normally low daily resident impact, effective observed mitigation and current regional relevance, while retaining all attribution limits. Recurrent important violence/common-route constraint40, stronger low-impact/effective-response combination80; reject impact/scope/continuation to null.

dimensions.rationale: Actual municipal complaint remedies, accessible paper/non-digital alternatives and multi-agency fire/IT-fault response support operating institutions. Complaint selection, partial remedies, neighbourhood/group differences, survey denominator conflict and common digital faults retain weaknesses.
dimensions.assumption: Accept usual residents can access ordinary service, remedies and non-digital alternatives, and observed emergency arrangements continue. Significant persistent delivery/cohesion/recovery failures40, broader actual outcomes/backups80; reject reach/recovery/scope to null.

dimensions.rationale: Actual water quality and interruption records, operating food distribution, heating/electricity delivery and transport links support normally reliable affordable basic supply under the profile assumptions. Drought/groundwater and heat-grid/power/aging common dependencies remain important.
dimensions.assumption: Accept normal end-user safe water, basic food/energy affordability at local median income, actual supply availability and continuation beyond observed institutional periods. Significant supply/cost/common-source constraint40; stronger affordable operating substitutes80; reject household/scope/continuity connection to null.

dimensions.rationale: Registered actual multi-hospital hip-fracture surgery, measured outcomes/processes, rehabilitation planning, advanced referral and public payment support a limited usually available necessary-care path. Persistent low 24-hour surgical timeliness and acute readmission are material; 30-day elective choice does not mitigate acute delay.
dimensions.assumption: Accept usually appropriate, sufficiently timely affordable necessary care through the operating network and usual registered public coverage. Persistent acute-fracture timeliness/readmission and insufficient usable alternatives can support40 without majority injury; reliable stronger quality/backup combination80. Reject quality/timeliness/payment/scope to null.

dimensions.rationale: Real local disease-limited CAR-T delivery and a current operating multidisciplinary programme, positive qualified CAR-T adoption and usual public hospital payment support credible translation with constrained maturity/access. AD non-adoption, eligibility, monitoring, capacity and long-term uncertainty remain; no healthy lifespan claim.
dimensions.assumption: Accept actual old disease-qualified local delivery plus the2025 operating programme and current recommended routes continue, and ordinary eligible public patients can obtain necessary funded therapy/monitoring without disabling production/wait/care costs. Do not assume age/disease/PS eligibility. Material residual access/capacity constraint40, stronger multiple actual affordable pathways80; reject local-current-pay-monitor connection to null.

dimensions.rationale: Multiple university/industry producers, actual commercial agreements/startups, operating digital infrastructure and observed uptake support strong sustained multi-node capability. National/company scope, copper transition and age/skill differences remain; contracts and coverage are not universal delivered benefits.
dimensions.assumption: Accept multi-campus/local reference representativeness, continued output/industry use and national/digital service applicability to537 ordinary residents. Mitigated skill/transition barriers must not create a major diffusion break. Important residual diffusion/industry barrier60; reject actual sustained adoption/scope to null.

dimensions.rationale: Actual aviation and road/rail routes, scoped EU citizen migration, bank transfer procedures and operating networks/roaming provide usable alternatives. Shared bridge structure, aviation closure and telephone/payment common faults remain important; legal permission alone does not create a score.
dimensions.assumption: Accept valid Danish citizenship/identity, lawful destination conditions/resources/insurance, usable transport capacity, ordinary authenticated account/funds and matching roaming/equipment; ordinary alternative channels remain practical under known faults. Significant exit/transfer constraint40, stronger normally executable common-fault substitutes80; reject eligibility/resources/scope/continuity to null.
